newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV sees positive 97 earnings development.
newsitem.headline: OMV sees positive 97 earnings development.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals firm OMV on Monday forecast good earnings development this year.

"At this point in time we can expect a positive earnings development for the current year," chief executive Richard Schenz told shareholders. He did not specify which earnings figures he was referring to.
Earlier OMV reported an 8.5 percent increase in first quarter earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) to 1.02 billion schillings ($84 million) from 945 million a year ago.
Sales rose to 21.45 billion schillings from 17.77 billion.
In 1996 the group achieved a 14.5 percent rise in net profit to a record 1.981 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254 ($ = 12.14 Austrian Schillings)
